description: Dealing with all of the recruitment needs & employment issues of the company.
Ensuring the timely recruitment of new employees into the business from the initial job offer being made through to their induction into the company including offer letters and contracts etc.
Process the enrollment of new recruits
Contacted all job applicants to inform them of their application status.
Thoroughly explained the employee handbook during new employee orientations.
Assist employees and customers alike in person and phone to ensure that all issues/concerns have been rectified within a timely manner.
Liaising with Managers/Supervisors of all departments to meet the demands for each department whether it is pertaining to recruiting or leave or benefits concerns/queries.
Acted as a Customer Service Representative (CSR)/Teller by opening accounts and processing transaction for members.

Assisted members in using the facilities that the branch offers, also providing information on the different types of products and services that the Society offered and also of the members of the group.
Prepared letters to customers and suppliers as directed.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents as a highly skilled professional in Human Resources, with extensive experience handling recruitment and processing needs within an organization. Their strong ability to provide timely and accurate HR advice across various departments reflects their practical skills in managing employee interests alongside those of the employers. The proactive attitude and confident demeanor displayed throughout their career highlight this candidate's suitability for roles where they can contribute effectively to organizational objectives through people-centered strategies.
